messages:
Ava (Design): Quick design check — compact trace view: does the Download CTA belong in the right-rail actions or the top header? screenshot: https://imgur.com/abc123 Sam (Product): I prefer header for discoverability, but right-rail keeps per-span context. downside: header CTA loses per-request scope Diego (EngRuntime): header is simpler for keyboard nav (tab to header -> download). right-rail would need aria-controls to announce which trace is being downloaded Jordan (Accessibility): +1 header if we can make it aria-describedby with trace id. Otherwise need aria-live update when download starts Ava (Design): WFH thought: what if header has global 'Download trace' and right-rail has 'Download snippet' for selected span? keeps both Maya (EngPlatform): That could work. Implementation note: the API for snippet download is a different endpoint. I can add a route: GET /traces/:id/snippet?span=:span Diego (EngRuntime): Perf: snippet extraction touches KV cache. add debounce and size cap. Also prefer a 3-state button: idle -> preparing -> ready Akira (Docs): Copy idea: header CTA: 'Download full trace (JSON)' right-rail: 'Download span snippet'. Keep concise and explicit Jordan (Accessibility): Keyboard/focus flow: focus should move into a dialog when 'Download' is triggered, with sr-only heading 'Downloading trace X' and aria-live polite messages for progress Ava (Design): UX microcopy nits: 'JSON' vs 'raw' — prefer 'JSON' since users expect machine format. And we need smaller icon-only affordance for mobile Sam (Product): Also we need correlation ID visibility: suggestion to make correlation chip sticky at top of drilldown and include copy-to-clipboard Maya (EngPlatform): We already have copy action on hover, but making it sticky helps mobile. Implementation: add pin toggle on chip that sets state in local storage Diego (EngRuntime): Also accessibility: chip needs to be focusable and announce 'Correlation ID: , copied' upon action Ava (Design): Visual: contrast of chip text on secondary background is low at small sizes — increase weight or change BG to #0f172a Jordan (Accessibility): Also add keyboard shortcut: 'D' when focus inside trace drilldown to trigger download. Make sure it doesn't conflict with other shortcuts Akira (Docs): We'll need to update quickstart and Keyboard shortcuts page if we add that Sam (Product): Rollout plan: canary in staging, flag behind feature toggle 'compact_trace_cta_v2' Maya (EngPlatform): I'll add the flag and wire it to per-team rollout percentage Diego (EngRuntime): Test notes: ensure KV cache isn't purged by snippet generation loop; also add perf test for big traces Ava (Design): Agree. small mock attached: https://imgur.com/abc123 — includes header CTA + pinned correlation chip Jordan (Accessibility): One more aria snippet for the download button, propose: ```html ``` Diego (EngRuntime): Minor tweak: aria-live shouldn't be on button; instead announce via an sr-only region after click Jordan (Accessibility): Good catch. change to: ```html
``` Ava (Design): OK let's converge: header 'Download full trace (JSON)' right-rail 'Download span snippet', sticky correlation chip with pin, keyboard 'D' to start download, sr announcements via hidden region. I'll update the figma and post new frames Sam (Product): SGTM. who owns follow-ups? Ava (Design): I'll own figma + copy. Maya owns platform flag. Diego owns perf tests. Jordan owns accessibility verification. Akira updates docs. I'll open tickets Ava (Design): thanks all :tada: deploy-bot: Feature flag 'compact_trace_cta_v2' created by Maya
